exercises.instructionEn: Use should or shouldn't to make sentences about driving safely, as in the example. 1 keep your eyes on the road 2 drink and drive 3 drive when you're tired 4 drive with the headlights on at night 5 drive carelessly
exercises.instructionUz: Xavfsiz haydash haqida should yoki shouldn't bilan gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 keep your eyes on the road 2 drink and drive 3 drive when you're tired 4 drive with the headlights on at night 5 drive carelessly
exercises.explanationUz:
SHOULD / SHOULDN'T - MASLAHAT
  (coursebook 43-bet qoidasi).

  SHOULD + fe'l = ... kerak
    (yaxshi maslahat)
  SHOULDN'T + fe'l = ... kerak
    emas (yomon narsa)

  ⚠ 'should' dan keyin fe'l ODDIY
  ShAKLDA ('to' siz).


XAVFSIZ HAYDASh:

  ✓ keep your eyes on the road
  ✗ drink and drive
  ✗ drive when tired
  ✓ headlights on at night
  ✗ drive carelessly


⚠ 'TO KEEP YOUR EYES ON':

  = ko'zni ... dan uzmaslik.


⚠ 'HEADLIGHTS':

  = mashina faralari.


⚠ 'CARELESSLY':

  = ehtiyotsizlik bilan. 'care' +
  'less' (-siz) + 'ly'.
exercises.exampleEn: You should keep your eyes on the road.
modelAnswers: You shouldn't drive when you're tired.
You should drive with the headlights on at night.

exercises.instructionEn: Use should or shouldn't and a verb from the list to complete the short dialogues below: stay, phone, eat, ask, spend.
exercises.instructionUz: should yoki shouldn't va ro'yxatdagi fe'l bilan quyidagi qisqa dialoglarni to'ldiring: stay, phone, eat, ask, spend.
exercises.explanationUz:
MASLAHAT - MUAMMOGA JAVOB.

  1 uy vazifasi → should ASK
    (o'qituvchidan so'ra)
  2 doim kiyim oladi → shouldn't
    SPEND (ko'p pul sarflama)
  3 mashina buzildi → should PHONE
    (mexanikka qo'ng'iroq qil)
  4 o'zini yomon his → should STAY
    (yotoqda qol)
  5 ozmoqchi → shouldn't EAT
    (yog'li ovqat yema)


⚠ 'IS ALWAYS BUYING':

  = doim sotib oladi (continuous +
  always = norozilik, jahl).


⚠ 'FATTY FOOD':

  = yog'li ovqat.


⚠ 'TO ASK SB FOR HELP':

  = birovdan yordam so'ramoq.

exercises.instructionUz: Akvarium balig'i egalariga maslahat beruvchi quyidagi varaqani o'qing va should yoki shouldn't bilan gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. AKVARIUM BALIG'INGIZNI QANDAY PARVARISh QILISh: 1 ✓ feed fish/small amount once a day 2 ✗ leave/fish tank in the sun 3 ✓ change/water once every two weeks 4 ✗ keep fish/in a small fish tank 5 ✓ put/some rocks in the fish tank
exercises.explanationUz:
MASLAHAT VARAQASI (coursebook
  43-bet loyiha - sog'lom ovqat
  varaqasi kabi).

  ✓ → You SHOULD ...
  ✗ → You SHOULDN'T ...


⚠ 'A LEAFLET':

  = varaqa (ma'lumot qog'ozi).


⚠ 'TO TAKE CARE OF':

  = parvarish qilmoq.


⚠ 'TO FEED':

  = boqmoq, ovqat bermoq.
  'a small amount' = oz miqdor.


⚠ 'A FISH TANK':

  = akvarium.


⚠ 'ONCE A DAY / ONCE EVERY TWO
  WEEKS':

  = kuniga bir marta / har ikki
  haftada bir marta.
exercises.exampleEn: You should feed your fish a small amount once a day.
exercises.exampleUz: Balig'ingizga kuniga bir marta oz miqdorda ovqat berishingiz kerak.
modelAnswers: You shouldn't leave the fish tank in the sun.
You should change the water once every two weeks.
You shouldn't keep your fish in a small fish tank.
You should put some rocks in the fish tank.
modelAnswersUz: Suvni har ikki haftada bir marta almashtirishingiz kerak.
Akvariumga bir nechta tosh qo'yishingiz kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or the future simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple yoki future simple shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
VAQT ERGASh GAPLARI - WHEN /
  BEFORE / UNTIL + PRESENT.

  ⚠ 'when', 'before', 'until', 'as
  soon as' dan keyin KELAJAK
  ma'nosida ham PRESENT SIMPLE:
  'before we WATCH' (will EMAS)
  'When Karen's plane ARRIVES'
  'until he FINDS'

  ⚠ Lekin SO'ROQ 'When ...?'
  (qachon?) - bu ergash gap EMAS,
  oddiy savol → WILL:
  'When WILL you find out?'
  'When WILL dinner be ready?'


⚠ FARQ:

  'When he comes, I'll call you' -
    ergash gap (qachonki) → present
  'When will he come?' - savol
    (qachon?) → will


⚠ 'TO FIND OUT':

  = bilib olmoq, aniqlamoq.


⚠ 'A TEDDY BEAR':

  = o'yinchoq ayiq.


⚠ 'UNTIL':

  = ... guncha.

items.textEn: Let's have dinner before we ___ (watch) the film.

items.whyUz: ⚠ SAVOL (qachon?) - ergash gap emas → 'will you find out'.

items.textEn: When Karen's plane ___ (arrive), please call me.
Kevin won't go to bed until he ___ (find) his teddy bear.

exercises.instructionEn: Make full sentences using the prompts, as in the example. 1 you/add yoghurt to curry/it/not taste so hot 2 plants/not get enough water/they/die 3 you/not put/milk in the fridge/it/turn/bad 4 you/press/this switch/the light/come on 5 you/heat/ice/it/melt
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalar bilan to'liq gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 you/add yoghurt to curry/it/not taste so hot 2 plants/not get enough water/they/die 3 you/not put/milk in the fridge/it/turn/bad 4 you/press/this switch/the light/come on 5 you/heat/ice/it/melt
exercises.explanationUz:
NOL TUR ShART (Zero Conditional)
  - UMUMIY HAQIQAT.

  IF/WHEN + PRESENT, PRESENT.
  ⚠ Ikkala qismda PRESENT SIMPLE
  (will YO'Q) - har doim shunday
  bo'ladi (tabiat qonuni, fakt).


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'If/When you add yoghurt to
   curry, it doesn't taste so hot.'


⚠ 3-ShAXS -S:

  'it turns bad', 'the light comes
  on', 'it melts', 'they die'
  (ko'plik - -S yo'q).


⚠ 'CURRY':

  = karri (o'tkir hind taomi).
  'hot' = o'tkir (achchiq).


⚠ 'TO TURN BAD':

  = buzilmoq (ovqat).


⚠ 'TO PRESS A SWITCH':

  = tugmani bosmoq.
  'the light comes on' = chiroq
  yonadi.


⚠ 'TO MELT':

  = erimoq.
exercises.exampleEn: If/When you add yoghurt to curry, it doesn't taste so hot.
exercises.exampleUz: Agar karriga yogurt qo'shsangiz, u unchalik o'tkir bo'lmaydi.
modelAnswers: If/When plants don't get enough water, they die.
If/When you don't put milk in the fridge, it turns bad.
If/When you press this switch, the light comes on.
If/When you heat ice, it melts.
modelAnswersUz: Agar o'simliklar yetarli suv olmasa, ular nobud bo'ladi.
Agar sutni muzlatgichga qo'ymasangiz, u buziladi.
Agar bu tugmani bossangiz, chiroq yonadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the phrases in the list to complete the short dialogues below: can I help, would you like, do you want, would like. Where does each dialogue take place?
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi iboralar bilan quyidagi qisqa dialoglarni to'ldiring: can I help, would you like, do you want, would like. Har bir dialog qayerda bo'lib o'tadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
TAKLIF va RAD ETISh (coursebook
  43-bet 15-16-mashqlar).

  TAKLIF:
    Would you like ...? (muloyim,
      rasmiy - restoran)
    Do you want ...? (oddiy - tez
      ovqat)
    Can I help you? (xizmat)
  QABUL: I would like ..., please.
  RAD: No, thank you. I'm full.


QAYERDA:

  A - QIMMAT RESTORAN ('madam',
    dessert menu, tea or coffee)
  B - TEZ OVQAT RESTORANI
    (cheeseburger, chips, Coke,
    'Do you want')


⚠ 'I'M FULL':

  = to'ydim.


⚠ 'MADAM':

  = xonim (rasmiy murojaat).


⚠ 'CHIPS':

  Brit. = kartoshka fri.
